title: M7: pixelelated 0.0.1
description:
## Current priority — settled post-rclone setup

D-CLOUD-179 reaffirms the solution; no owner decision on the overall validator direction is pending. Complete #515's source-derived targeted repair cases next, then integrate #508 and audit #507. The foundation proof is complete; integration and final firmware qualification are not.

## Ordered implementation path — M7.P5

1. **#510 — settled contract and reference alignment.** Link/retain the remote, then offer category checks, selected folder creation and instructions. Preserve independent paths. D-CLOUD-178/179 settle this; do not ask the owner to choose the overall design again.
2. **#515 — targeted save-folder repair cases and qualification (next implementation task).** Read public ROCKNIX filters/config and actual emulator writers; distinguish valid layouts from source-proven misplaced saves/states/screenshots. Define exact plans, bounds, collision/source-retention and consent; implement and prove supported actions. Unsupported/ambiguous cases retain instructions. If no safe automatic case exists, retain the case evidence and explicit disposition; never claim an unimplemented repair passed or silently drop a demonstrated requested case.
3. **#508 — coordinated final integration and pins.** Include the qualified foundation and #515's result, remove automatic move/follow and startup/tidy paths, and retain public config/credential preservation. Carry canonical references and proof with the source.
4. **#507 — freeze and independently audit the resulting P5 delta.** Required primary and cross-lab stages; no replay of the accepted candidate16 audit.
5. **#508/#492/#344/#265/#359 — assembled firmware and release gates.** Build the engineering image required for CF10 clean/public ROCKNIX adoption, map final inputs/inclusion, then finish source/licences and named physical/release gates. Source-overlay proof does not establish an installed RC.

**Parallel #511:** setup, ROM and BIOS guides and later verified QR destinations. Local instructions work without the website. The separate Herdr lane still awaits its startup trust answer; it is not a firmware gate.
## Current qualification

The check/create/instructions foundation has completed [source-overlay proof](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/d5e2f78618624cad919afaba6784bef3f7eaf8c7/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-07-cloud-validator/ui/README.md) at distribution `6f89bc7cecee5972909828103689e2c7c0711c30` and ES `4e410dc9a816cc947f16235ad2b24824b29dd84e`. Both product branches remain local/unintegrated; the product pin is unchanged. #512/#513/#514 are qualified source fixes and closed; their firmware inclusion belongs to #508.

Evidence: 21 restore controls, 30 validator controls, 1,311 top-level host PASS (zero FAIL/SKIP), ordinary VM WebDAV and SFTP 108 PASS each; 99 UI-index entries comprising 89 reviewed frames, nine rejected frames retained and CF10 assembled firmware/public adoption pending. #512 unit logic passed 183 cases/4,752 assertions; later text-only fixes have separate compile/link/syntax/catalog/vocabulary proof. All owned runtimes are retired and 529 sealed files retained. Accepted candidate16/device artifacts and the 78-frame firmware baseline are unchanged. No build, VM or audit job is running in this lane.

P3 GENERIC_X64 qualification and P4 fixes audit are complete on candidate16. All eight findings are resolved. Exact approved cleanup#491 is completed:22 QA disks,42.05GiB recovered and preservation independently verified.

1. **#495/#496 complete: host compiler and proof repaired.** Exact upstream-matched controls, full installed SPIRV package, nine shader checks and independent hashes published on next63ef759a. Failed owners and all interrupted package scopes are preserved.
2. **#492 H700 arm and #497 actual handoff proof COMPLETE.** Accepted compatibility output is present byte-for-byte in the verified firmware. The source repair and failed owners remain preserved; issue reconciliation follows the retained artifacts.
3. **#492 H700 firmware artifact acceptance COMPLETE.** Both DDR variants, raw/update payloads, installed identity, ARM handoff and independent custody verified; physical boot remains separate. Cleanup #493/#494 and its #498 limitation remain recorded.
4. **#492/#503/#506 SM8550 firmware artifact acceptance COMPLETE.** SM8550 firmware artifacts are ACCEPTED from frozen0553c0193ace3aebbefaae5b7b6d49253c2811d9. All737 packages completed; build04 returned0 at16:51:14UTC and its fourzero channels/13seals/exits were verified16:51:39. Independent firmware acceptance passed16:52:00; fourzero channels/3seals/exits and controllerPASS were consumed16:52:09. Raw/update equality, GPT/ABL, lowercase identity,187ARM handoff files,14FEX files, and installed qualified English/French migration copy passed. Independent bundle97367c3235fab7cc6d1ec2b54c390fe7ceff786612f29c9f177aaa288a33fb18 is retained; scratch was removed. Original01 product and02/03 helper failures remain preserved. Source/licence inventory, per-image qualification mapping, named physical smoke and publication remain separate; no Nova deployment or RC designation. Evidence: docs/qa-logs/2026-10-07-device-builds/sm8550-resume04/.

5. **#500 RG35XX SP adoption COMPLETE.** Authorized H700 transfer and one reboot applied pixelelated0.0.1 /43d0bc3bf4. Installed-byte/bootloader/DTB equality, changed boot ID, empty queue, original mounts and active interface verified11:25UTC; terminal channels/seals/exits verified11:26UTC. Next: separately named device smoke and other device adoption, corresponding source,14 known licence metadata gaps, public docs and manifest-bound assets. Other hardware actions and publication retain named scope; no RC designation.

Can this be done on the VM? Common software qualification is complete. Compiler controls run in the pinned host container; capacity and compilation are host facts. Physical smoke facts stay separate. SM8550 compilation follows H700 without implying approval to flash either.

**Retention policy #493 (completed batches; ongoing rule):** D-INFRA-022 keeps a large testing artifact only for a named active or immediately queued test with a release condition. Completed cleanup and accepted H700/SM8550 artifacts above are history, not a second build queue. Follow the current P5 order for new work; retain compact verifiable logs, inputs, results, frames and failure explanations, and retire scratch after its named proof. Disconnected alerts #395, FOSS observability #432 and RA reset automation #464 remain later work. No personal-cloud credential or new RA reset is required.

### M7.P1 — Completed source work (migration portions superseded by #508)

1. **Migration controls and shared state model** — #365 with #356 and fixture correction #390: map applicable actors to T01–T26 assertions, preserve independent settings/content choices, and retain failing controls for the missed transitions. #391 owns inherited partial states; #392 owns missing-remote refusal.
2. **Versioned, repeatable migration** — #356: strict malformed/future-marker handling, numbered steps/journal, failure at tier or marker publication, safe retry and second-device follow. Name the actual older-build compatibility boundary; do not claim RC2 understands a future protocol.
3. **Settings recovery locking** — #320: deterministic concurrent-write and lock-busy controls, then fix stale recovery-record publication.

P1's historical source gate was subsequently qualified on candidate16. D-CLOUD-175/#508 now retires its cloud-folder move/follow engine; retain those proofs as history. Settings recovery locking and format safety remain required.

### M7.P2 — Work in order

1. **Current proxy with no functionality loss** — #361 and #384: reconcile local patches with current upstream, prove >100-game preparation, never count queued work as ready offline, preserve cached sign-in/data and queued base/subset awards through upgrade/reconnect.
2. **Compatible current dependencies** — #362 and #386: libsoup/WebKit build inputs plus glslang, SPIR-V headers, cbindgen and tllist; verified sources, compatibility and package checks. Coupled dependencies retain evidenced parent pins. Distribution ancestry remains frozen by D-WORKFLOW-111.
3. **Remaining software and execution gates** — #310 launch-memory cause/fix, #332 LED script/reselection, #371 push-hook fix, #367 process guard/help, #368 remaining handoff armatures. Diagnostic VM builds are allowed when required to investigate these.

#327's explanation-page source/frame/asset criteria are completed; public site publication remains P5. Upstream contribution #168 can proceed with qualified local fixes; upstream acceptance does not hold the candidate.

### M7.P3 — Work in order

0. **Lowercase pixelelated transition** — #409 identity source, sibling pins, cloud default, active addresses/policies and source controls are complete above. The RGB555 LCD asset system, Ocean splash/ES/theme integration and fresh input freeze are complete; candidate16 installed behavior proof is accepted. No RASTERATOPS predecessor gate. Repeat applicable qualification on new bytes; #409 is completed after final candidate 16 qualification and the P4 audit; old candidate evidence stays historical.

1. **Freeze, cold-build and retain the exact artifact** — #383/#344: distro/ES/splash commits, container digest actually consumed, source inventory, concurrency, fresh lowercase pixelelated root, logs, candidate manifest and digest verification before/after QA. #393/#394 provide corrected activity detection and automatic monitoring for future builds; the completed image keeps its frozen source. #395 retains disconnected delivery as an explicit outstanding infrastructure item; active-session supervision accompanies the durable watcher. A detached status file is not an alert.
2. **Clean install and RC2 upgrade; actual cloud paths** — #354 and #349/#350/#351/#352/#353/#363/#364/#365/#366/#376/#377/#379/#380/#381. Run full VM QA plus required opt-ins, local WebDAV/SFTP/MinIO-S3, independently reset promoted cases, pair migration, interrupted retries/future markers, writer-shaped archives, and injected failing controls.
3. **Preservation, performance and identity** — #361/#362/#384 runtime proofs; #310 memory/launch loops; #364 timing; #327 explanation frame/docs; #332 software fixture/UI evidence; #337 identity/manual update; #357 no upstream reporting; #359 licences. English/French at 640x480 and Nova1280x960, time-to-play and image brand/secret/localisation/source checks.

**Engineering-build gate is not the RC gate.** Image-only acceptance criteria must remain open until the image exists and supplies proof. They do not prohibit that engineering build. An RC claim requires the known software bugs resolved and P4 completed; no RC2 bug waiver carries automatically.

### M7.P4 — Work in order

The fixes review #383/#471 is complete, with all eight findings resolved on rebuilt and qualified candidate16. #375/#382 are the completed initial review and dispositions; do not restart any completed audit. Verified cross-lab receipts and installed resolutions remain retained. The general automatic version/depth policy is later #378, not a missing authorization for this review.

### M7.P5 — Work in order

The ordered implementation path at the top is authoritative: #510 contract → #515 concrete repair cases/qualification → #508 coordinated integration → #507 frozen delta audit → assembled firmware, public/clean adoption and release gates. No new pin/build or external audit started during the planning reconciliation. Existing source-overlay proof is retained; changed inputs receive affected requalification. The engineering image required for CF10 is allowed after the source/audit steps; CF10 cannot close before that image exists.

Historical device work: #502's EN/FR migration copy is qualified in ES5d2fcb9b/distribution0553 and the accepted SM8550 artifact. #504's authorized SP review found an incomplete owner migration; #505's extra diagnostic draft was superseded by #508 and closed not planned. Those results do not authorize resuming move/follow or require support for unpublished experimental states. D-CLOUD-175/178/179 replace that product flow with post-connection checks and explicit creation/actions.

The owner reports manually resetting experimental cloud state and requests separate read-only verification and a later one-time residue review (#516). Personal timestamps, paths and inventory stay private; the issue carries redacted conclusions only. This is not proof of reset device settings or a public adoption seed. No move/delete/sync is inferred and this operational task adds no release gate.

#492 retains accepted H700 and SM8550 artifact history. After final qualified inputs are frozen, build and verify the affected firmware in the approved H700-then-SM8550 order, with per-image input/inclusion mapping. #265/#344 own release selection, corresponding source, notes/recovery/public documentation and manifest-bound assets; #359 owns licences. Named physical smoke follows software qualification. No Nova deployment or new RG35XX SP action is inferred; retain each hardware fact and action's scope. No RC designation or publication until the applicable gates pass.

## Placement and historical references

M7-wide umbrellas: #383 delivery, #344 release contract, #354 cloud scope. Their titles omit P because they span phases. Other open titles use their owning M7.P phase. An input issue assigned P2 can retain image-only acceptance for P3; title placement does not waive that criterion.

The older #344 headings remain **contract sections**, not this execution queue: contract P0 is historical investigation; contract P1 spans current P2/P3 custody; contract P2 maps to current P3; contract P2b/P3/P4 map to current P5; contract P5/P6 are later work. Cite `#344 contract P2` explicitly rather than renumbering that evidence.

Both are M7.P5 work. #511/D-WORKFLOW-152 is active parallel website planning, without a firmware release dependency. Linking or choosing a folder is not relocation consent (D-CLOUD-176).
